notes.title: Spooky Ghosts Dot Com 1.1 Released
notes.content:
Patch Notes:


[b]New difficulty settings:[/b]
-you can now choose between easy and normal difficulty
--normal is the regular original Spooky Ghosts Dot Com experience
--easy difficulty causes enemies to deal less damage and candy drops also have a small chance to heal you
--existing saves will default to normal
--you can update the difficulty at any time during the game on the pause menu

[b]Quality of life improvements:[/b]
-spikes no longer cause instant death, they cause 3dmg on normal and 2dmg on easy instead
-adjusted some boss hitboxes slightly
-projectiles or enemies spawned by bosses will be destroyed when the boss dies, with the exception of Feast Master turrets, this is to prevent cases where you could be killed by the boss after the boss had died
-frogs during the witch fight take 2 hits to kill instead of 3

Thank you!
